notes.title: Working on Scary Humans’ next update
notes.notes:
At Gabhel Games, we are aware that a game must be in constant evolution and the community’s opinions are crucial to the product’s success. That is why Scary Humans will keep evolving and improving, getting everything on point, adding players’ suggestions, including new game modes… 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26637949/072ba50f4950fc340a6cf3f783e06cc64016ba1c.png

These will all be free updates for all our players who have relied on the game. If you have any suggestions, queries or anything else to point out, please send them through either Steam’s community or to hello@scaryhumans.com. Scary Humans is not our game, but your game.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26637949/f6346458995f20441000aadea94ac9f6baaddaba.png

And don't forget to follow us on Twitter at @scaryhumans.
